author: Vital_Maniac
body: I was banned ages ago and cannot stop thinking about Avicus. I am so bored on minecraft and I have been for a month! Please can I be unbanned? It's hard to do anything on minecraft without Avicus. I'm so stupid for hacking in the first place and i will never do it again in my life!!!! I have learnt my leason and I'm ready to come back to Avicus! If u ever catch me hacking again u can ban me for life!!!!!! I promise my hacking days ARE OVER.
